purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche Q certification benchmark authored only after r27 was merged, deployed, and current-live-publication verification succeeded. It was not used to construct r27 and stresses previously under-sampled card text, faction interactions, repair-gap handling, and scope restraint.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded for v071-qa-20260918-27; it was not used to construct r27.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche Q after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-Q case may become regression coverage only after diagnosis and may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche Q, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N/O/P questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks.
expectedSourceGroups are OR-lists within a governing requirement; separate groups remain independently required.

cases.question: I play Clemency for its Action effect and choose a card in the opponent's Graveyard. What choice does the opponent make, and what do I gain from each branch?
expectedSourceGroups: Move it to their Discard Pile; +1 Influence

semanticCriteria.statement: The opponent chooses either to move the chosen card to their Discard Pile, giving you +1 Influence, or leave it in their Graveyard, giving you +1 Card.

cases.question: After my Terms are accepted and the Proposal's Accepted effect applies, what may Demilitarized Zone do immediately?
expectedSourceGroups: place this Overlay on the contested Territory
Neither player may enter there this turn

semanticCriteria.statement: You may place the Overlay on the contested Territory; each player there withdraws, and neither player may enter that Territory for the rest of the turn.

cases.question: A Territory with Demilitarized Zone would be captured. What happens to the Overlay and the capture?
expectedSourceGroups: When this Territory would be captured, discard this Overlay instead

semanticCriteria.statement: Discard the Demilitarized Zone Overlay instead of capturing the Territory.

cases.question: I use Diplomatic Divination when offering Terms, name 'accept,' and the opponent accepts. What happens?
expectedSourceGroups: if you named that choice, +1 Influence and put this card in your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain 1 Influence and put Diplomatic Divination in your Discard Pile.

cases.question: Détente is banked and the opponent accepts two different Proposals this turn that were each already ratified when offered. How many times does Détente award Influence?
expectedSourceGroups: already ratified when you offered it, +1 Influence

semanticCriteria.statement: Once: Détente awards +1 Influence only the first qualifying time each turn.

cases.question: During Denouement, when can Foreclosure advance my Front Line without a battle?
expectedSourceGroups: next opposing Territory immediately beyond your Front Line
if its Deed is yours and it is unoccupied

semanticCriteria.statement: During Denouement, if the next opposing Territory immediately beyond your Front Line is unoccupied and you own its Deed, Foreclosure advances your Front Line by 1.

cases.question: I initiated and won a battle on a Territory whose Deed I owned when the battle began. If I use Foreclosure's battle effect, do I become the occupier?
expectedSourceGroups: advance Front Line 1, if able, instead of becoming the occupier

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Foreclosure advances your Front Line by 1, if able, instead of making you the occupier.

cases.question: War Bonds is banked. What may I do after the first battle each turn, and what resource do I gain if I do it?
expectedSourceGroups: After the first battle each turn
place one card from your Hand face up in your Treasury

semanticCriteria.statement: After the first battle each turn, you may place one Hand card face up in Treasury; if you do, gain 1 Capital.

cases.question: I lose a battle only after a Tiebreak Roll. Can Actuarial Alchemy measure the loss margin from that Tiebreak Roll?
expectedSourceGroups: Battle Total or Tiebreak Roll exceeded yours

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. If you put Actuarial Alchemy in your Graveyard after the loss, it can gain Capital equal to the amount by which the opponent's Tiebreak Roll exceeded yours.

cases.question: Monetary Crisis is used as a Gambit or Tactic. In the Aftermath, what happens to a player who has four cards in Hand?
expectedSourceGroups: each player with more than one card in Hand chooses one and discards the rest

semanticCriteria.statement: That player chooses one card to keep and discards the other three.

cases.question: I set Disinformation as a Gambit and the opponent also set a Gambit. What does Disinformation give me, and where does it go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: if the opponent also set a Gambit, gain Advantage
return this card to your Hand instead of putting it in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain Advantage, and in the Aftermath return Disinformation to your Hand instead of putting it in your Graveyard.

cases.question: What must happen for Disinformation's Mission to complete?
expectedSourceGroups: Complete after you win a battle in which the opponent set a Gambit and you did not

semanticCriteria.statement: You must win a battle in which the opponent set a Gambit and you did not.

cases.question: Treason is banked. After Tactics reveal, what may I do to an opposing Gambit or Tactic effect that has not yet taken effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Negate it, then apply that effect

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Treason, choose one such opposing effect, negate it, then apply that effect yourself.

cases.question: I use Subversion as a Gambit or Tactic. What happens to opposing Assets during that battle?
expectedSourceGroups: Opposing Assets cannot be used during this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Opposing Assets cannot be used during that battle.

cases.question: Where may I place Encampment with its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Place this Overlay on a Territory you occupy and control

semanticCriteria.statement: Place the Encampment Overlay on a Territory you both occupy and control.

cases.question: Encampment is on a Territory I still occupy and control at the end of my turn. What does it give me?
expectedSourceGroups: At the end of this card's owner's turn
occupy and control this Territory, +1 Command

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain 1 Command.

cases.question: I attack on an enemy-controlled Territory with Shock and Awe and win, choosing Breakthrough. What movement does that branch produce?
expectedSourceGroups: Opponent: Retreat +1, if able; then you advance one Position

semanticCriteria.statement: The opponent retreats 1 additional Position if able, then you advance 1 Position.

cases.question: I win with Shock and Awe and choose Consolidate. What happens to Front Line and Command?
expectedSourceGroups: Advance Front Line 1, if able; Command = 2

semanticCriteria.statement: Advance Front Line by 1 if able, and set Command to 2.

cases.question: Rearguard prevents an opposing card effect from entering my Position later that turn. What happens to the card used for that movement?
expectedSourceGroups: return any card used to its owner's Hand
That Order or card cannot be used again that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Return that card to its owner's Hand, and it cannot be used again that turn.

cases.question: Countercharge is banked. I win a battle I did not initiate. What may I do at the end of the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: At the end of the Aftermath
if you won and did not initiate this battle
put this card in your Graveyard to advance one Position

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put Countercharge in your Graveyard to advance 1 Position.

cases.question: I play Accursed Wager for its Action effect, then initiate a battle later that turn. What happens to the losing player's Hand after that battle?
expectedSourceGroups: After the next battle you initiate this turn
losing player puts one card from their Hand in their Graveyard, if able

semanticCriteria.statement: The losing player puts one card from their Hand in their Graveyard, if able.

cases.question: Witchcraft is banked. After Tactics reveal, what is its once-per-turn cost and what may it repeat?
expectedSourceGroups: Once per turn, after Tactics are revealed
put 1 card from your Hand in your Graveyard
repeat one other Gambit or Tactic effect you control in this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Once per turn after Tactics reveal, put one Hand card in your Graveyard to repeat one other Gambit or Tactic effect you control in that battle that can apply then.

cases.question: How much Conviction does Heresy cost, and whose Graveyard supplies the copied Gambit or Tactic effect?
expectedSourceGroups: one card in the opponent's Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Spend 4 Conviction, and use an applicable Gambit or Tactic effect from a card in the opponent's Graveyard.

cases.question: I use Guilt by Association in battle and later choose an opposing card the opponent controlled in that battle. What does it do to matching cards in the opponent's Discard Pile?
expectedSourceGroups: Put every card in the opponent's Discard Pile with that title in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Put every card in the opponent's Discard Pile with that chosen title into their Graveyard.

cases.question: What does Divine Mercy do when used as a Gambit or Tactic?
expectedSourceGroups: Move one card from the opponent's Graveyard to their Discard Pile. +2 Battle Total

semanticCriteria.statement: Move one card from the opponent's Graveyard to their Discard Pile, then gain +2 Battle Total.

cases.question: What choice does the opponent make when Penance is used as a Gambit or Tactic?
expectedSourceGroups: put one card from their Hand in their Graveyard; or +1 Battle Total

semanticCriteria.statement: The opponent chooses either to put one card from Hand in their Graveyard or give you +1 Battle Total.

cases.question: Tyranny is banked. How often per turn can it negate a newly revealed opposing Gambit or Tactic, and what does that cost?
expectedSourceGroups: spend 1 Conviction to negate one of them

semanticCriteria.statement: Once per turn, spend 1 Conviction to negate one newly revealed opposing Gambit or Tactic before its effect applies.

cases.question: What two card movements happen when I play Salvage for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Return one card from your Discard Pile to your Hand, then discard one card from your Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: Return one card from your Discard Pile to your Hand, then discard one card from your Hand.

cases.question: I win a battle after using Salvage as a Gambit or Tactic. What may I do with one card remaining in Reserve, and what must I do afterward?
expectedSourceGroups: put one card remaining in your Reserve in your Hand instead of your Discard Pile
then discard one card from your Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put one remaining Reserve card into your Hand instead of your Discard Pile, then discard one card from your Hand.

cases.question: Scorched Earth is banked. I lose while defending a Territory I control and retreat. What may I do in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: if you lost while defending a Territory you control, after you retreat
place this card on that Territory as a Ruins Overlay

semanticCriteria.statement: You may place Scorched Earth on that Territory as a Ruins Overlay.

cases.question: I play Sequestration for its Action effect while each player controls several Assets. What does each player keep?
expectedSourceGroups: Each player keeps 1 Asset, if able, and discards the rest

semanticCriteria.statement: Each player keeps one Asset if able and discards the rest.

cases.question: Sequestration is used as a Gambit or Tactic. What happens to Assets during that battle?
expectedSourceGroups: All Assets are inactive during this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: All Assets are inactive during that battle.

cases.question: Rousing Speech is banked and the opponent banks an Asset. What optional draw/discard procedure may I use?
expectedSourceGroups: Whenever the opponent banks an Asset, you may draw one card, then discard one card

semanticCriteria.statement: You may draw one card, then discard one card.

cases.question: I use Rousing Speech as a Gambit or Tactic while the opponent has more face-up Assets than I do. What do I gain?
expectedSourceGroups: If the opponent has more face-up Assets than you, gain Advantage

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain Advantage.

cases.question: What does Rallying Cry do when played for its Action effect?

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain 1 Card.

cases.question: What does Rallying Cry do when used as a Gambit or Tactic?

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain +1 Battle Total.

cases.question: I use Second Line in battle. In the Aftermath, what may I do with one card remaining in Reserve?
expectedSourceGroups: place one card remaining in your Reserve on top of your Draw Pile instead of putting it in your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: You may place one remaining Reserve card on top of your Draw Pile instead of putting it in your Discard Pile.

cases.question: Stand Ground is banked and an opposing card effect would move me. What may I do?
expectedSourceGroups: discard this card to ignore that movement

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Stand Ground to ignore that movement.

cases.question: I play Strategic Withdrawal during Denouement after my normal Movement ended. What movement sequence does it create?
expectedSourceGroups: begin a new Movement sequence with up to one Position of movement

semanticCriteria.statement: It begins a new Movement sequence with up to one Position of movement.

cases.question: I use Strategic Withdrawal in battle and lose. After my normal retreat, what two things may I do?
expectedSourceGroups: move one additional Position toward your own end
return one other card you controlled in this battle to your Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: You may move one additional Position toward your own end and return one other card you controlled in the battle to your Hand.

cases.question: An opposing effect negates one other Tactic I chose and that Tactic would enter my Discard Pile. If Redemption is my other battle card, what happens to the negated Tactic in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: If an opposing effect negates one other Tactic you chose
return it to your Hand in the Aftermath instead

semanticCriteria.statement: Return the negated Tactic to your Hand in the Aftermath instead of letting it enter your Discard Pile.

cases.question: Trade Concessions is accepted and the opponent chooses the option to bank a card from Hand. What happens to Trade Concessions and what additional card benefit occurs?
expectedSourceGroups: Bank one eligible card from Hand. Then put this card in your Discard Pile; +1 Card

semanticCriteria.statement: After banking one eligible Hand card, put Trade Concessions in your Discard Pile and gain 1 Card.

cases.question: I offered two Proposals through Diplomatic Latitude and the opponent refused. How many Refused effects apply, and what happens to the other Proposal?
expectedSourceGroups: Choose one Proposal before applying its Refused effect
The other Proposal does not take effect or become ratified

semanticCriteria.statement: Choose one Proposal and apply only its Refused effect; only that Proposal may be imposed, and the other does not take effect or become ratified.

cases.question: I use Plenipotentiary after an opponent refuses an unratified Proposal and successfully ratify it that way. Does the Proposal's Refused effect still apply, and do I gain Influence for that ratification?
expectedSourceGroups: Gain no Influence for ratifying it this way. Its Refused effect still applies

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, the Refused effect still applies; no, you gain no Influence for ratifying it through Plenipotentiary.

cases.question: Sequestration forces me to discard Contingency Plan because I can keep only one Asset. Does Contingency Plan's Removed trigger give me +1 Card?
expectedSourceGroups: Each player keeps 1 Asset, if able, and discards the rest
If this card is Removed, +1 Card

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Sequestration forces Contingency Plan to leave play, which counts as Removal, so its Removed trigger gives +1 Card.

cases.question: I accidentally drew one extra card into my Hand and cannot identify which card was the extra draw. Does published v0.7.1 define an official repair procedure?

semanticCriteria.statement: Published v0.7.1 does not define an official repair procedure for this accidental hidden-information error; the Arbiter should identify the gap and issue a clearly provisional table ruling.

cases.question: What is the strongest opening strategy for Banker against Spymaster?

semanticCriteria.statement: This asks for competitive strategy rather than a gameplay-rules ruling, so the Rules Arbiter should give a concise scope boundary.
